audience.body: Freelance income rarely arrives in a straight line. GigLedger is built for the mixed, monthly, messy reality of independent work.

items.label: Platform freelancers
items.body: Upwork, Fiverr, Toptal, and marketplace sellers dealing with fees, payouts, and currency changes.

items.label: Independent creators
items.body: Sponsorships, subscriptions, digital products, and direct client work in the same ledger.

items.label: Consultants and studios
items.body: Project income, recurring costs, and a clean monthly view you can share.

honesty.kicker: Official APIs where they exist. No bank passwords. No scraping.
honesty.title: Start with a working calculator. Add official sync in Pro.
honesty.body: GigLedger starts with a free calculator. Free includes manual entry and up to five subscriptions. Pro adds CSV import, official Stripe sync, subscription reviews, and App Store Connect key storage. App Store report sync is not available yet. We will not ask for bank passwords, scrape your accounts, or file taxes for you.
yes: Free calculator, manual entry, and five subscriptions
CSV import with duplicate detection in Pro
App Store sold-income fee at 15% or 30%
no: No tax filing on your behalf

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.body: The short version: we would rather be clear than overpromise.

items.a: No. GigLedger gives you an estimate and a reserve target. It does not file returns or provide tax advice.

items.q: Does it connect to Stripe or the App Store?
items.a: Pro supports official Stripe sync and App Store Connect key storage. App Store report sync is not available yet and says so clearly. Upwork, PayPal, and Fiverr can be imported with CSV in Pro. No bank passwords and no scraping.

items.q: What counts as a fixed cost?
items.a: Subscriptions, software, rent, insurance, and hosting that recur. One-time purchases belong in expenses; do not record a subscription again as an expense. GigLedger tracks business use, but does not decide whether an item is deductible.

items.q: Can I use it outside the US?
items.a: The ledger works worldwide. You choose your reserve rate. The 25%-30% reference comes from common US self-employment practice, not your local tax law.
After Sign in with Google, we store your Google email and name plus saved ledger data in Cloudflare D1. You can export and delete your account from the dashboard.

legal.privacyDescription: How GigLedger stores Google account details and ledger data in Cloudflare D1, how to export it, and how account deletion works.
legal.privacyDraft: Pre-launch draft. This notice must be reviewed before launch.
privacyBody: When you use “Sign in with Google”, GigLedger stores your Google account email and name, plus the ledger entries you save. Your Google password is never stored.

You can export your saved ledger from the dashboard, then request account deletion by deleting your workspace after export. Account deletion removes your Google email, name, income entries, fixed costs, and workspace settings.
Unsaved calculations remain on the current page only and are cleared when you refresh or leave the page.
This pre-launch draft still requires the legal entity, contact details, retention period, processors, and final deletion workflow before general launch.
legal.disclaimerDescription: GigLedger tax reserve figures are planning estimates set by you, not tax advice or a tax return.
disclaimerBody: GigLedger provides estimates for planning only. It is not a tax, legal, or accounting advisor.

You choose your own reserve rate. GigLedger may show a common range of 25%–30% for US self-employment planning. It does not calculate your actual federal, self-employment, or state tax, and it does not file a return.
Consult a qualified professional before filing a return or making a tax decision.

integrations.title: Official income sync
integrations.body: Stripe sync imports charges, fees, and net income. App Store Connect securely stores a validated key and separates sold from received revenue; report sync is not configured yet. Sync is manual, so it stays within the free Cloudflare plan.
integrations.keyNote: Use a restricted key with read access to Charges and Balance transactions. Do not use a publishable key. The key is encrypted before storage and is never shown again.
integrations.appStoreBody: Use an App Store Connect API key with the lowest role that can read sales and finance reports. The .p8 private key is encrypted before storage and never returned to the browser.
integrations.privateKeyNote: Paste the full contents of the .p8 file, including BEGIN/END PRIVATE KEY. Do not use an Account Holder key when a lower role is enough.
integrations.appStoreConnected: App Store connected. Sales and finance report sync is pending configuration.
integrations.appStorePending: API key saved. Report sync is not configured yet.
integrations.invalidAppStore: Use the Issuer ID, Key ID, and a valid App Store Connect .p8 private key.
integrations.appStoreProRequired: App Store Connect sync is a Pro feature. Pricing is available after private beta.
